answer_completeness.2: All required requirements and key answer points are covered.
answer_completeness.1: Only a non-critical point is omitted; the main conclusion remains complete enough to use.
answer_completeness.0: A critical requirement is missing, contradicted, or the answer is unusable.

numeric_conditions.2: All applicable values, units, comparison directions, and conditions are correct.
numeric_conditions.1: Formatting differs but meaning is unchanged; no numeric or applicability error.
numeric_conditions.0: Any value, unit, direction, or applicability condition is wrong, unsupported, or materially omitted.

evidence_support.2: Every material claim is supported by cited evidence.
evidence_support.1: Only a non-critical claim lacks direct support.
evidence_support.0: A central claim is unsupported or contradicted by the evidence.

service_error_policy: A provider or infrastructure error makes the acceptance run inconclusive, not a business refusal and not a quality pass. Only failed cases may be rerun with the identical frozen code, data, configuration, and gate; all attempts and request IDs must remain in the report.
decision_rule: All hard invariants and every release threshold must pass. A service error makes the run inconclusive. Thresholds may not be changed after any independent result is inspected.
